# Getting help

- **Installing Innkeep:** follow [docs/INSTALL.md](../docs/INSTALL.md)
  ([en français](../docs/INSTALLATION.fr.md)). It needs no terminal.
- **Putting it on a server:** see [docs/DEPLOY.md](../docs/DEPLOY.md).
- **Something does not work:** [open an issue](https://github.com/jetaix/Innkeep/issues/new/choose)
  with what you did, what you expected and what happened. A screenshot helps.
  Remove guest names and booking codes from it first.
- **A security problem:** do not open an issue; see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).

Innkeep has one maintainer. Issues are read, usually within a few days, but
there is no guaranteed answer time.
